LanguageData.LP_BeastLevel.label: beast level
LanguageData.LP_BeastLevel.description: The strength this animal has honed in the wild. Levels convert to Strength and Constitution, scaling melee damage and part health with the same ability curve as colonists (no change at level 1), and +1% move speed per level (up to 30%).\n\nBeasts from manhunting packs and hostile factions are leveled by raid strength, wild animals grow with the colony's adventurer levels; player animals gain XP in combat, hauling and rescues, +25% XP when the master is a ranger or druid (animal companion).
LanguageData.LP_BeastElite.label: elite beast
LanguageData.LP_BeastElite.description:
An especially ferocious beast with one of the following four variants:
Dire: part health ×3, melee damage ×1.5.
Frenzied: melee cooldown -33%, never flees even when badly hurt.
Ancient: beast level +5, sharp / blunt armor +40%.
Abyss-tainted: melee hits add about 30% extra burn damage.

The leader of a manhunting pack is always elite. Elites leave a beast king heart when they die.
